ITEM 1 | Scrambled-looking pale yellow mass with soft, curd-like clumps and folded irregular pieces, with scattered orange-tinged bits and a slightly glossy, moist surface; spread across the upper-left-center of the plate, roughly 12 cm by 9 cm footprint, about 1.5 cm thick at the thickest clumps, mostly soft and holding loose shape | 140

ITEM 2 | Bright green florets with dark green, slightly ruffled edges and a matte, slightly moist surface; cut into several bite-sized florets with short thick pale stems, clustered in the lower-center of the plate, about 9 cm by 7 cm footprint and 3 cm tall, with some darker charred-looking specks on the tips | 90

ITEM 3 | Thin smear of pale orange-brown residue with faint streaks along the right-lower edge of the plate, slightly glossy and thin, flat against the plate surface, covering roughly 4 cm by 2 cm | 5
